author: pk910
content:
yea,  the buildoor instance is the worst,  only 6 peers.

I think it might be related to grandparent bids.  In local devnets I found that grandparent bids (bids for blocks building on the grandparent, so for the case of a block reorg) were accepted by lodestar,  butother peers (primarily lighthouse) heavily downscored that bid.   Litterally one bid was enough for a disconnect and node ban.
It might be that buildoor built some of these grandparent bids and submitted them via the buildoor lodestar instance.

author: potuz
content: Yes, if proposer of N equivocates and the equivocation acquires 20% of votes, then the the proposer of N+1 can give it proposer boost, giving that branch 60%, this is the reason why the other branch requires at least 60% to beat it.
